stories.text: {petName} sat by the pond and counted ripples until {they} lost count and started again. It was a very good kind of nothing.
{petName} found a tiny lost mitten and hung it on a low branch so its owner could spot it. {They} felt quietly proud all the way home.
{petName} lay in the grass and saw a cloud shaped like a teapot. Then a whale. Then, maybe, you.
{petName} pressed {their} nose to a bakery window. The baker waved. {They} waved back, a little too hard, and nearly fell over.
{petName} discovered moss so soft {they} took a nap on it. Explorers need rest too.
{petName} watched two snails race. Nobody won. Everyone seemed fine with that.
{petName} jumped in {their} very first puddle. Then the second one. Then all of them.
{petName} climbed to the old lighthouse and watched boats find their way home. {They} thought of you and hurried back.
{petName} found a reading nook and read half a book about stars. {They} saved the other half for another day.
A street musician played a song {petName} didn't know, and {they} hummed along anyway. Some songs are like that.
{petName} saw flowers that only open at night. {They} whispered goodnight to each one.
{petName} shared shade with a tired traveller. They didn't say much. They didn't need to.
{petName} helped a kid untangle a kite. It flew higher than both of them expected.
{petName} leaned against a very old tree. It had stood through many storms, and it was still here. {They} found that comforting.
